pages.text: Iron-tier pickaxe that voids and propagates. Hits to Supreme Furnace shell blocks break instantly and start a chain that steadily destroys every connected casing — about 100 blocks per server tick. Cascading destroys do not consume durability.

pages.title: Warning
pages.text: $(thing)Voids mined furnace blocks$() — nothing drops, neither the broken block nor the cascade. Use $(item)Supreme Wrench$() to disassemble normally if you want the casings back.
